text:
alex: quick async standup — evening pulse. TL;DR: looked at SLO noise, followed up on paging flow, small reliability work landed.
priya: what you did: looked at the recent alert storm on eu-west embed nodes? any root cause yet?
alex: saw increased 5xxs during the 18:20-18:40 window. preliminary: KV eviction + cold starts + a routing fallback hitting an older quantized model.
mateo: blockers? do we need an emergency rollout rollback? :eyes:
alex: not rollback. mitigations applied: bumped warmup concurrency for the autoscaler, pinned routing to primary model group, and increased KV cache retention by +10s. watching.
jun: can you paste the offending log snippet? might help triage with the oncall.
alex: pasted below — noise is from the batcher timeouts:
```
2026-03-17T18:22:13Z ERROR batcher/handler.go:142 request_id=req_12ab timeout=504 model=redwood-7b-v1 route=fallback
2026-03-17T18:22:13Z WARN  kv/cache.go:87 evicted_prefix=embeds:user:recent
```
priya: ok thanks. I'll check the alert rule thresholds and see if we can debounce the initial flurry without hiding real failures.
ops-bot: paging update: eskalation sent to oncall @jun at 18:24; status=acknowledged.
jun: acked and looked at traces — root span shows long queueing in batcher before GPU handoff. potential hotspot in batching window when concurrency spikes.
mateo: followups for tomorrow: 1) add temporary debounce on embed-5xx alert for eu-west, 2) open a perf ticket to add pre-warm on new instances, 3) run a stress test to reproduce eviction pattern.
alex: added the three TODOs to the oncall board and linked the trace. also left a snippet in the runbook notes.
priya: small ask — can someone do a quick CR review for the autoscaler bump? it's tiny: change is +1 line to target concurrency.
mateo: I'll take it now.
jun: thanks — if we still see >1% 5xx after the warmup tweak, we'll escalate to a canary rollback. for now, keep monitoring and update this thread. :thumbsup:
alex: will update at 19:00 with current SLO burn and if further action needed. good night team.
